summary: Copy of the production b12x.comm.roce (RoCEnante one-shot, unchanged and still the default) with the pipelined two-shot all-reduce of flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6915 ported in. Selected only by DSV41_ROCE_TWOSHOT=1 (runtime/roce_twoshot_adapt.py); routed per call by DSV41_ROCE_TWOSHOT_ROWS (adapter/roce_twoshot.py, default 0 = every all-reduce one-shot).

source.title: feat(experimental/b12x): extend RoCE collectives and neighbor-ring transport
source.author: Luke Alonso (lukealonso)

base_of_the_copy.package: b12x.comm.roce (runtime/b12x/source-provenance.json: b12x 85d3681 + RoCEnante 081b2359, ds41 columns all-gather)

ported: _twoshot_cute.py: the upstream kernel body (doorbell, chunked staging, owner reduction in FP32 rank order, chunked all-gather, pipe_done-gated epoch) unchanged, behind a ds41 sequence-0 guard

_roce_proxy.c: per-slot op kind, the pipe region (pipe_send, pipe_recv[src][2], pipe_flag[2][src][chunk][hca]), post_striped, post_pipe_chunk, run_pipe_op with the pipe_done release, kind dispatch in proxy_main
roce_oneshot.py: pipe_bytes / pipe_blocks / pipe_chunk_bytes, the counter layout, pipe geometry and the two-shot launch
ds41_changes: a separate package so the production one-shot stays byte-identical; ABI 103 (stock 3) and a distinct cached proxy library name
ported onto the older vendored RoCEnante (no _routes/_tuning/_preparation, no ring or variable-length gathers, HCA = rail); ctrl region grown to 4096 bytes
imports adapted to this b12x _lib (functools.cache instead of program_cache / attach_programs); compile ids comm.roce_twoshot.*

routing by rows (pipe_min_rows / pipe_min_rows_fn, _twoshot_plan.py) instead of a byte threshold; pipe_bytes <= max_size so misaligned tensors stage through the one-shot alignment scratch (no pointer-dependent routing); explicit twoshot= override for the probe

a two-shot op after the 32-bit sequence wrapped fails closed (ready words, pipe flags and pipe_done compare equal to seq, exact until a wrap); upstream instead stops every op at INT32_MAX, which would stop a long-running server; one-shot ops keep the stock behaviour
not ported from the same PR: the neighbor-ring transport, the variable-length all-gather and the sequence-space exhaustion stop

every kernel of the copy (one-shot, both all-gathers, two-shot) poisons the runtime at sequence 0 before touching a flag or payload (error word and peer 0xFFFFFFFF, poison 0xFFFFFFFF, epoch frozen); the host refuses further collectives once the doorbell sequence is within 2^20 of the wrap (sticky), so in practice no kernel reaches sequence 0
ROCE_TWOSHOT_ROUTE is logged once per (threshold, rows, bytes, dtype), so each in-boot A/B variant's routed shapes are provable

2026-10-28 idle parking (DSV41_ROCE_IDLE_PARK=1, off by default; independent implementation, idea: idle RDMA proxy parking (uchkw)): _roce_idle_park.h (new) and seven '#if defined(ROCE_IDLE_PARK) && ROCE_IDLE_PARK' blocks in _roce_proxy.c (futex park in the idle branch, kick in roce_stop, roce_park_* API); _proxy.py builds with -DROCE_IDLE_PARK=1 under its own cache name only when IDLE_PARK is set. Without the define the source minus those blocks is f744d83's byte for byte and the compiled .text/.rodata/.data/.dynsym are identical (tests/test_roce_idle_park.py)
verified_offline_2026_10_25: tests/test_roce_twoshot.py: production package hashes; copy kernels differ from production only by the kind word; kernel/proxy ctrl words; owner reduction uses the one-shot helpers in rank order; 4-rank byte-level protocol model bit-identical to the one-shot (uneven, empty shards, 64-chunk cap); routing; adapter; overlay selection
the proxy builds with gcc -Wall -Wextra -Werror against libibverbs (Linux arm64); roce_layout matches the Python model

every CuTe kernel of the copy (one-shot, all-gather, two-shot bf16/fp32, ranks 0 and 3) compiles for sm_121a with nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.6.3, no GPU: 33-40 registers, no local memory; the copy's one-shot SASS differs from production by one STG.E.STRONG.SYS (the kind word)

tests/test_roce_twoshot.py SequenceWrap simulates every copy kernel's control flow at sequence 0 against CPU words with every flag reporting ready (no flag or payload touched, error/poison set, epoch frozen; fails with the guard removed) and the host guard; all kernels recompile for sm_121a with the same registers
verified_on_fleet_2026_10_26: four DGX Sparks (GB10, TP4, CX-7 through a RoCE switch), DSV41_ROCE_TWOSHOT_ROWS=18, B12X_ROCE_PIPE_BLOCKS=4, B12X_ROCE_PIPE_CHUNK_BYTES=65536: T=0 outputs with top-20 logprobs byte-identical to production on 75 qeval prompts in a fresh-boot A / B / A' bracket; speedbench load c16 +3.7 to +4.9 %, c1 / c4 within noise
